subject.title: refactor(config): retire flat streaming keys from the last six channel schemas via doctor migration

question: Should the shipped `ReplyRuntimeConfigSchemaShape` remain backward-compatible through the stated Plugin SDK deprecation window, or is this PR intentionally approving an immediate breaking Plugin SDK change?
rationale: The current branch changes a shipped public schema in place, while the preceding merged compatibility fix promised continued third-party flat-key support; only an owner can authorize overriding that contract.

options.title: Preserve the shipped SDK surface
options.body: Add a separate nested-only primitive for bundled consumers while retaining the existing public shape and fields through the deprecation window.

options.title: Approve an immediate SDK break
options.body: Land the replacement only with explicit breaking-change approval, external plugin migration guidance, and real upgrade proof.

options.title: Split the migration batch
options.body: Land channel-local migrations separately and defer the shared Plugin SDK contract change.

recommendation.title: Preserve the shipped SDK surface
recommendation.body: Add a separate nested-only primitive for bundled consumers while retaining the existing public shape and fields through the deprecation window.

likelyOwner.reason: The git history ties this owner to the public schema, migration DSL, resolver compatibility decision, and current branch.
